handover_metadata.role: Synthetic Laboratory Data Simulator & Deterministic Ground-Truth Rule Engine Lead
handover_metadata.project: VAULT - Offline Laboratory Evidence & Validation Platform

completed_modules.description: Deterministic laboratory data generator producing SOP clauses, instruments, lots, samples, experiments, and CSV runs spanning 9 scenario families with random.Random(seed).
Five deterministic laboratory validation rules: validate_sop, validate_calibration, validate_lot, validate_holding_time, and validate_measurement.
Decimal-based unit conversion and measurement uncertainty interval evaluation against SOP specification tolerances.
Comprehensive schema, syntax, uniqueness, foreign key, unit, measurement, ledger, and summary validation routines.
I/O handlers for JSONL, CSV, configuration loading, and SHA-256 content hashing.
CLI entrypoint for running the simulator and producing data/raw/ datasets.
CLI entrypoint for executing all 5 validation rules against experiments and generating data/ground_truth/ground_truth_ledger.jsonl and reports.
CLI entrypoint for comprehensive dataset and ledger validation.

needs_review_gap_analysis.policy_note: Ground-truth verdict labels were determined strictly by the deterministic rule engine without artificial manipulation or label tampering.
scenarios_to_adjust_for_higher_proportio: Schedule experiment runs during the SOP-003 overlap window (2025-05-15 to 2025-05-31) to trigger SOP_VERSION_CONFLICT.
Increase proportion of deliberate missing evidence records (e.g. from 25 to 50-60).
Widen simulated measurement uncertainty intervals on border cases to induce more boundary crossing conditions.

validated_integrity_constraints: All required schema fields present across all 6 datasets
Strict identifier uniqueness (clause_id, instrument_id, lot_id, sample_id, experiment_id)
Valid ISO-8601 dates (YYYY-MM-DD) and datetimes across all timestamps
Foreign key referential integrity (100% resolution for Valid experiments; controlled missing/mismatches for review scenarios)
SOP version consistency and clause mapping
Measurement units adhere to canonical and recognized laboratory units
Measurement values are numeric and uncertainty intervals are non-negative
Ground-truth ledger completeness (exactly 800 records, 1:1 correspondence with experiments)
Deterministic verdict policy adherence: VALID when all pass, INVALID when failure exists and no review, NEEDS_REVIEW when any review check exists
Abstention consistency: abstain is True if and only if verdict is needs_review
Reason codes preserved and matched between check-level outputs and ledger record
Structured evidence references correctly preserved in every ledger entry

known_limitations: Simulator generation with seed 42 yields 9.00% needs_review rather than the 20-25% target because the overlapping SOP-003 window (2025-05-15 to 2025-05-31) was not hit by random experiment run dates.
The deterministic validation rules require exact catalog lookup; if an instrument or lot is missing from the catalog, it flags MISSING_REQUIRED_EVIDENCE rather than inferring default values.

Unit conversion in synth/units.py currently targets mass concentration (mg/L canonical); non-concentration parameters (pH, %, NTU, AU, °C) are evaluated directly in their canonical units without scaling.

for_rohit.focus: Data ingestion, database storage, and evidence indexing pipelines.
for_rohit.guidance: 1. Ingest raw datasets from data/raw/ into your operational database. 2. The primary foreign keys are clause_id, instrument_id, lot_id, and sample_id. Note that review experiments may contain null foreign keys (Missing evidence) or deliberate mismatches. 3. Read data/ground_truth/ground_truth_ledger.jsonl to access the ground-truth validation status and reason codes for each experiment. 4. Use the evidence array in each ledger record for entity relationship graphing.

for_pawan.focus: Offline AI/LLM evaluation, agent benchmarking, and guardrail verification.
for_pawan.guidance: 1. Do NOT allow the LLM to assign or modify ground-truth verdicts. 2. Use data/ground_truth/ground_truth_ledger.jsonl as the strict reference evaluation benchmark. 3. For any experiment where abstain is True (verdict == 'needs_review'), the LLM/agent must abstain or escalate to human review. If the LLM generates a definitive 'valid' or 'invalid' answer on an abstained record, flag it as a benchmark hallucination/failure. 4. Use reason_codes to verify if the LLM's explanation identifies the correct root causes (e.g., CALIBRATION_EXPIRED, HOLDING_TIME_EXCEEDED).
